name: fix_kotlin_missing_when_branch
description: Completes a non-exhaustive when expression over an enum (compile error)
prompts: src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/OrderFlow.kt does not compile: the `when` EXPRESSION over OrderStatus is missing the CANCELLED branch, and Kotlin requires when-expressions over enums to be exhaustive. Fix OrderFlow.next so it compiles and handles every status: NEW -> PAID, PAID -> SHIPPED, SHIPPED stays SHIPPED, and CANCELLED stays CANCELLED (a cancelled order never advances). Prefer an explicit CANCELLED branch over an `else` catch-all.
